title: John Ramirez on human-alien hybrid programs

tellings.quote:
GS15 and he's come out now and I think
on your show as well saying that like
he's sure we have hybrid programs, human
alien hybrid programs.

plain: A former official named John Ramirez, who held the rank of GS-15, one of the highest grades in the US civil service, has said publicly that he is sure the United States has programmes to make human-alien hybrids. Michels repeats this on the show as something Ramirez has said, and he thinks Ramirez said it on his own show too. If true, it would mean the government is not just studying visitors but mixing with them.
